# MapAttribution

Provider-neutral map credits and an independently optional brand slot, available on React, SwiftUI and Compose. The host supplies ordered entries with unique IDs, plain-text labels and optional absolute HTTP(S) destinations. Kozmos renders that content; it never selects a provider, invents copyright wording or inserts a year.

- **Import:** `import { MapAttribution } from "@kozmos-ds/react";`
- **Group:** Product SDK
- **Platforms:** React, SwiftUI and Compose; not linked to Figma yet.
- **Storybook:** <https://vodoco.github.io/kozmos-design-system/storybook/?path=/docs/product-sdk-mapattribution--docs>

## Example

From its `Default` story.

```tsx
import { MapAttribution, ThemeProvider } from "@kozmos-ds/react";

export function MapAttributionExample() {
  return (
    <ThemeProvider defaultTheme="light">
      <MapAttribution
        credits={[
          { id: "indoor", label: "© Example indoor data" },
          {
            id: "outdoor",
            label: "Outdoor contributors",
            href: "https://example.com/credits",
          },
        ]}
      />
    </ThemeProvider>
  );
}
```

## MapAttribution

Provider-neutral map credits with independently optional branding.
No SDK detection, provider wording, dates or persistence are owned here.

It forwards its ref to `HTMLElement`. Its props are `MapAttributionProps`, which extends `React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLElement>`.

- `credits`: `readonly MapAttributionCredit[]`, **required**.
- `brand`: `React.ReactNode`, optional.

  Replaces the bundled Pointr logo. Custom content owns accessibility and sizing.

- `showBrand`: `boolean`, optional, default `true`.

  Controls branding only, never the supplied credits.

- `appearance`: `"map" | "surface"`, optional, default `"map"`.

  Map uses transparent, haloed credits; surface uses an opaque themed background.

- `label`: `string`, optional, default `"Map attribution"`.

  Localized accessible name of the attribution region.

- `children`: `ReactNode`, optional.

It also takes the attributes React's DOM types give it (`className`, `style`, `id`, `aria-*`, the event handlers among them).

## Types these props take

### MapAttributionCredit

From `@kozmos-ds/react`.

```ts
/** Presentation data supplied by the host, in display order. IDs must be unique. */
interface MapAttributionCredit {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  /** Absolute HTTP(S) destination. Unsupported URLs render as plain text. */
  href?: string;
}
```
